run_clustering_pipeline: run the full AV-HuBERT clustering pipeline with k-means on a SLURM cluster using submitit
dump_av_hubert_features: dump AV-HuBERT features from a TSV dataset using a checkpoint and specified layer index
dump_mfcc_features: dump MFCC features from a TSV dataset across multiple shards for audio clustering
run_kmeans_learning: learn k-means clusters from dumped features using k-means++ initialization and configurable batch size
apply_kmeans_labels: apply a trained k-means model to assign cluster labels to feature shards
